Text strips the C1 controls and the deprecated shaping switches too, and pad and truncate sanitize what they add

The high review: C1 (U+009B is CSI) passed Text while TextInput refused it; pad/padLeft/padRight's char and truncate's marker reached the text unsanitized; PDF and PDI close a state rather than open one; U+206A-U+206F hold state as the bidi controls do. The test derives the bidi set from \p{Bidi_Control}. NEL in a code span is now stripped as the C1 control it is.

Text strips the bidi controls that open a direction state, so content cannot reverse the rest of its line (0.24.1)

U+202A-U+202E (embeddings, overrides) and U+2066-U+2069 (isolates) join the C0 set in stripControlChars, the one sanitizer every Text passes. An unclosed U+202E in content reversed whatever the terminal drew after it on the line; cc-candybar measured one in a lit ticket description reaching the bar (brandon-unfiled-3248.qum). The marks (LRM, RLM, ALM) open no state and pass.

A tween eases a value from one to another over seconds (rich-animation-42lg.bjh) (#480)

* A tween eases a value from one to another over seconds (rich-animation-42lg.bjh)

`tween(from, to, timing)` in `src/core/tween.ts`: `from` before 0, eased
toward `to` through `Phase.once(0, seconds)`, held at `to` from then on,
with `nextChange` saying so — until 0, every frame, never. The blend is
`(1 − p)·from + p·to`, exact at both ends where `from + (to − from)·p` is
not, so a count lands on its target whatever the ease.

`Timing` is the ease-and-seconds pair, in `easing.ts`: what `spring()`
returns (replacing the `Spring` interface, the same shape under the name
of its one producer) and what an effect's `Curve` now extends, so a spring
is handed to a tween as it is.

A colour tween is `ColorRamp.over(seconds)`: the ramp's span crossed at a
steady rate, each colour the ramp's own, so the blending stays in one
place. Retargeting is `Animation.sequence(old, t₁, tween(old.at(t₁), to,
timing))`, documented and tested, with no state kept.

`docs/animation.md` gains the tween section; the colour studio demo gains
a tween row, which is what demonstrates the export to the coverage gate.

* tween's doc says what an ease that jumps at 0 shows, and ramp's header names its imports (review high)

* A tween to where it already is is the constant, so an equal-ended move never wobbles an ulp (review medium)
